    # Ants are at (x, y) moving in (dx, dy)

    # 1. Reach an edge.
    # 2. Collide.
    
    min_t = float('inf')
    
    for i in range(len(ants)):
        if not ants[i]['alive']: continue
        x, y = ants[i]['pos']
        dx, dy = ants[i]['dir']
        
        # Time to edge
        if dx > 0:
            t_edge = (N - x) / dx
            min_t = min(min_t, t_edge)
        elif dx < 0:
            t_edge = (0 - x) / dx
            min_t = min(min_t, t_edge)
            
        if dy > 0:

            min_t = min(min_t, t_edge)
        elif dy < 0:

            min_t = min(min_t, t_edge)
            
    # Time to collision
    for i in range(len(ants)):
        if not ants[i]['alive']: continue
        for j in range(i + 1, len(ants)):

            xi, yi = ants[i]['pos']
            dxi, dyi = ants[i]['dir']
            xj, yj = ants[j]['pos']
